text:
deploy-bot: Canary signal: /v1/chat route p95 latency up 2.2x after rollout to v4.1.0. Auto-rollback candidate available but route is pinned in some regions. Recommend human review.

nina_eng: I'm seeing the same in staging and canary. Latency spike correlates with longer context lengths in incoming requests.

owen_ops: Note: EU-west pools are pinned by customers to v4.1.0. Auto-rollback is blocked for those. Hosted unpinned traffic can revert automatically.

ramona_cs: prepping customer note drafts. If we perform a hosted-only rollback, do we need to alert pinned customers?

policy_bot: Policy check: pinned pools require explicit operator consent before rollback if change affects SLA metrics. Emergency clause allows immediate action when errors >= 1.5% or p95 >= 1s. Current p95 ~880ms, errors 0.4% (not yet emergency).

nina_eng: Proposal: allow hosted auto-rollback to v4.0.7, start 10m watch. For pinned regions, open a manual rollback ticket and notify customers with a heads-up template.

owen_ops: Agreed. I'll trigger hosted autorollback and create a per-pool rollback plan for EU-west. Command proof: `deployctl rollback --scope hosted --to v4.0.7 --confirm` then `monitor rollout --route /v1/chat --metric latency_p95`.

ramona_cs: I'll hold the customer note in drafts; send only if we touch their pools or if emergency threshold is met. Template ready.

deploy-bot: Hosted auto-rollback initiated at 1788888905 -> target v4.0.7. Rolling back streaming and non-streaming variants.

nina_eng: telemetry after revert: p95 dropped to 260ms on hosted canary. No error spike.

owen_ops: For EU-west pinned pools we have a rollback runbook but need customer opt-in unless emergency. I'll open runbook with steps and CS copy: `runbook/rollback-dedicated.md` (internal).

policy_bot: Decision logged: allow hosted autorollback only. For pinned pools, require customer notification and operator approval unless emergency triggers within 15m.

nina_eng: I'll follow up with kernel trace and prompt-length distribution. Add a canary test for long-context requests.

ramona_cs: CS notified internal channel. Preparing brief for customers once we have RCA.

(emoji reactions: :white_check_mark: from owen_ops, :eyes: from nina_eng)
